caption: The drawing depicts a single ornate saddle with detailed etching and carvings, rendered predominantly in various shades of brown, tan, and beige. The saddle features a high backrest and a prominent horn at the front, both adorned with intricate patterns. The fenders, seat, and skirt are decorated with floral and geometric designs, with the floral motifs occupying circular and rectangular sections along the sides. A pair of matching stirrups dangle from both sides, each also decorated with patterns. Some leather straps hang loosely from the saddle. The background is a plain, light beige color with no additional objects, and the artist’s signature, “Arthur E. Reynolds,” appears below the saddle toward the right.
title: Spanish Southwest Saddle
